note.question: How do attention and ad content interact?
note.overview: This article studies the consumption of advertising when attention is costly. The model's objective is to understand the advertiser’s optimal decision for informational and noninformational content when facing consumers with heavy distractions common in the digital age. We take an equilibrium approach in which an ad is consumed if and only if the content of the ad is worth the viewer’s attention.
